projects.name: Semiconductor Manufacturing AI Solutions | Client: Lam Research
details: Intelligent Process Recipe Generation
Engineered GPT-4 with RAG architecture processing 500,000+ historical recipes and SEM imaging data to optimize semiconductor fabrication parameters across etching, deposition, and cleaning processes
Achieved 65% process development time reduction (8 months to 2.8 months) with $25M annual R&D savings and 78% first-time recipe success rate improvement
Multi-Modal Equipment Troubleshooting Assistant
Developed GenAI assistant integrating GPT-4V, YOLO v8, and AR/VR technologies for real-time equipment diagnosis and repair guidance across 96,000+ global semiconductor chambers
Reduced MTTR by 55% (8 hours to 3.6 hours) with 82% first-time fix rate, delivering $85M annual savings through enhanced equipment uptime
Automated Technical Documentation System
Architected Claude-3 documentation system with document AI to generate, maintain, and translate 50,000+ technical documents across semiconductor manufacturing processes
Delivered 70% documentation time reduction and 85% writer productivity improvement with 220% increase in cross-team knowledge sharing
Process Anomaly Detection Platform
Built Transformer-based anomaly detection with causal inference engines analyzing 50TB+ daily sensor data, providing natural language explanations for process deviations
Achieved 96.5% detection accuracy with 80% false positive reduction, preventing $45M annual yield losses and reducing root cause time from 36 hours to 15 minutes
Advanced Materials Discovery Platform
Designed platform combining graph neural networks and physics-informed ML with automated experimentation for next-generation semiconductor materials development (3nm+ nodes)
Accelerated materials discovery by 70% (3 years to 10 months) with $60M R&D cost reduction and 67% screening hit rate improvement
Predictive Equipment Maintenance System
Implemented ensemble ML models (XGBoost, LSTM) analyzing 200+ sensor parameters to predict equipment failures and optimize maintenance scheduling across global manufacturing fleet
Reduced unplanned downtime by 73% (5.2% to 1.4%) saving $18M annually with 67% MTBF increase and 45% consumable waste reduction

projects.name: AI-Powered Sales Assistant | Client: Cisco
details: Architected conversational AI chatbot using ChatGPT-4.0 and Langchain for commerce cloud environment, improving query resolution time by 40%
Implemented advanced RAG applications with domain-specific knowledge integration, enabling 25% faster
information retrieval
Delivered 20% operational efficiency increase through enhanced virtual assistant capabilities and 90%+ user satisfaction scores

Technologies: GPT-4, GPT-4V, Claude-3, RAG, Langchain, XGBoost, LSTM, Transformer, Graph Neural Networks, Physics-informed ML, YOLO v8, OpenCV, AR/VR, AWS SageMaker, Kubernetes, Apache Spark, Vector Databases, Causal Inference, MLOps

projects.name: Document Processing System | Client: Vanguard
details: Led team of 4 engineers developing Computer Vision OCR system using OpenCV and Pytesseract for automated legal document extraction with 97% accuracy
Deployed scalable web application on AWS EC2 with APIGEE and PingFederate security, processing 300+ documents daily
Implemented end-to-end MLOps pipeline with automated monitoring and version control, reducing manual processing time by 80%
Technologies: OpenCV, Pytesseract, AWS EC2, APIGEE, PingFederate, Docker, MLOps

projects.name: Healthcare Analytics Dashboard | Client: Roche
details: Designed Tableau dashboards with automated web scraping using BeautifulSoup, pandas, and scrapy for Oncology, Neurology, and Ophthalmology data
Developed data processing pipeline with CSV integration, missing value imputation, and interactive visualizations
Technologies: Random Forest, XGBoost, scikit-learn, Tableau, BeautifulSoup, pandas, scrapy

projects.name: Matching NLP System
details: Built NLP model using spaCy, NLTK, and Gensim doc2vec for automated resume screening with 60% similarity threshold
Deployed production model via Flask API on ALT Recruit platform, improving recruitment efficiency by 50% Technologies: spaCy, NLTK, Gensim, doc2vec, Flask API, Cosine Similarity
